description: Pull the LLM client's repeated usage-token read, thinking switch, strict-schema object pass and tool-call parsing into named helpers.

Share one plain-r.txt guard and one source_checks reader/writer across the freshness probe, the seed-act backstop and the r.txt sampler, and name the daily run's per-source check and status classification.
Collect fetch_texts' six loose run counters into a small _Tally dataclass, and give the КСУ snapshotter a named _record_snapshot step for its provenance row.

Read every gold and golden JSONL file through one reader in retrieval_eval, and give the harness named helpers for the per-question tally, the persisted run and noise files, the stub result envelope and backend selection.
Split both model pins into named assertions (bootstrap, model name, score drift, ordering) and give the embedding and lemma index builders a shared one-cell query helper and a batch-write step.

Give the retriever one candidate-row builder and one citable-identity key instead of a copy per channel, and lift the cross-encoder rerank and the exact-first merge out of search() and the gate's verdict, retry turn and attempt record out of generate().
